settings.question: How thick is your glass?
settings.answer:
Our glass panels are 12mm (1/2 inch) tempered glass, about double the thickness of an average car window. 12mm is the minimum many building codes set for frameless glass railings, so check the rules where you live on our building code pages.

The panels come 33.6", 39.6", 46" and 57.7" high, for 36", 42", 48" and 60" railings. See all glass railing panels.

settings.question: What stainless steel is your hardware made of?
settings.answer:
Our spigots, the 6" Engineered Spigot and the Side Mount / Fascia Spigot, are made from 2205 marine-grade stainless steel, designed to resist rust in even the harshest conditions. Our hardware comes in Brushed Stainless or Matte Black and is covered by our 10-year no-rust promise.

Read 2205 vs 316 stainless steel to see how it compares.

settings.question: How is the gate latch mounted?
settings.answer: It is mounted on pre-holed glass panels, for 12mm gate glass panels.

settings.question: Which gate panels should I use?
settings.answer: Use our gate glass panels, holed for the hinges, latch and floor lock.

settings.question: What size is the 180° connector?
settings.answer: Dimensions: 1.25" x 4".

settings.question: How much space between the glass panels?
settings.answer: Our glass connectors are made for 0.5" to 2" of space in between the glass panels.

settings.question: Which glass does it fit?
settings.answer: It is made for use with 12mm glass panels.

settings.question: Which sizes are available?
settings.answer: Small (25mm) and Large (40mm), in Brushed Stainless or Matte Black.

settings.question: What else do I need?
settings.answer: Select the appropriate cap rail connectors to complete the installation: straight connectors, corner connectors and end caps.

settings.question: What total railing height does this panel give?
settings.answer: When paired with our glass railing spigot, the total height reaches 36".

settings.question: Are spigots included?
settings.answer: Spigots are sold separately. Choose the 6" Engineered Spigot or the Side Mount / Fascia Spigot.

settings.question: Can I return glass panels?
settings.answer: This is a final sale product, so returns and exchanges are not permitted. Because our glass products are made-to-order and cut to your specifications, we do not accept returns, exchanges, or cancellations of glass based on change of mind, ordering errors, or incorrect measurements.

settings.question: How far apart should the spigots be?
settings.answer: Mark spigot positions at a maximum of 36 inches apart along the top edge of your deck frame or concrete surface. In our installation guide each glass panel slides into two spigots.

settings.question: What total railing height does this panel give?
settings.answer: When paired with our glass railing spigot, the total height reaches 42".

settings.question: What total railing height does this panel give?
settings.answer: When paired with our glass railing spigot, the total height reaches 48". With a side-mount installation, the total height of the system is 42".

settings.question: What total railing height does this panel give?
settings.answer: When paired with our glass railing spigot, the total height reaches 60".

settings.question: What are the spigot dimensions?
settings.answer: Dimensions: 4" x 4", 6" height. Weight: 5lbs. Material: 2205 Marine Grade Stainless Steel.

settings.question: Are screws included?
settings.answer: Screws and mounting bolts are sold separately. Choose the right hardware for your installation surface from our concrete and wood screws.

settings.question: Which finishes are available?
settings.answer: Brushed Stainless and Matte Black.

settings.question: Is the rubber insert included?
settings.answer: Yes. Included with each cap rail is a 6ft rubber insert.

settings.question: Which sizes are available?
settings.answer: Two sizes: the small cap rail with a 25mm width and the large cap rail with a 40mm width.

settings.question: How is the corner gate latch mounted?
settings.answer: It is mounted on pre-holed glass panels and designed for use with 12mm glass panels.

settings.question: What size is the 90° connector?
settings.answer: Dimensions: 1" x 2.75".

settings.question: Which glass does it fit?
settings.answer: It is designed to securely join 12mm glass panels at a 90-degree angle.

settings.question: Which angles does the adjustable connector cover?
settings.answer: It comes in two sizes. The Big size adjusts from 45° to 180° and the Small size from 90° to 180°.

settings.question: Which glass does it fit?
settings.answer: It is made for aligning and securing 12mm glass panels at varying angles.

settings.question: Are these gate panels pre-holed?
settings.answer: Yes. They are holed for the hinges, the latch and, depending on the option you choose, the floor lock.

settings.question: Can I return gate panels?
settings.answer: This is a final sale product, so returns and exchanges are not permitted.

settings.question: What hardware goes with them?
settings.answer: Our gate hardware: hinges, gate latches and the floor lock.

settings.question: What are gate support panels for?
settings.answer: They are designed to work with self-closing doors and glass gate hardware, adding stability and support to the gate.

settings.question: Which hinges do I need?
settings.answer: Use the Hinge Kit (2 units): the Straight option connects the gate to an adjacent glass panel and the Wall option mounts it to a wall, post or masonry surface.

settings.question: Can I see samples before ordering?
settings.answer: Yes. The Glass & Hardware Sample Kit lets you see the glass and hardware before you order your railing.

settings.question: How do I get a quote for my project?
settings.answer: Submit a plan request with your measurements, photos or drawings and we will send you a detailed quote on the materials necessary for your project. You can also call or text (855) 452-7715.

settings.question: What is in the hinge kit?
settings.answer: Each kit includes two hinges.

settings.question: Wall or Straight?
settings.answer: The Wall option mounts your glass gate to a wall, post or masonry surface. The Straight option connects your gate to an adjacent glass panel.

settings.question: Which glass does it fit?
settings.answer: The Hinge Kit is designed for use with 12mm glass panels.

settings.question: Which screws do I need?
settings.answer: Concrete screws for concrete surfaces and wood screws for wooden surfaces, in 3" or 4".

settings.question: Are screws included with the spigots?
settings.answer: Screws and mounting bolts are sold separately. Choose the right hardware for your installation surface from our concrete and wood screws.

settings.question: What are the side mount spigot dimensions?
settings.answer: Dimensions: 2" x 2", 5.5" height. Material: 2205 Marine Grade Stainless Steel.

settings.question: Does a side mount spigot change the railing height?
settings.answer: Yes. This spigot will reduce the height of your glass panels by 4".

settings.question: Which caprail sizes do the connectors fit?
settings.answer: Small (for 25mm Caprail) and Big (for 40mm Caprail).

settings.question: Where is the caprail?
settings.answer: See the 6ft Square Caprail and the 19ft Square Caprail.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Glass railing orders are processed in 2–3 business days, then delivered in 5–10 business days. Free shipping for glass railing orders over $3,000. The price displayed at checkout is the final price with no hidden fees, tariffs, or duties.
